description: This file defines a Flutter widget called HomeShell, which manages the main navigation and layout for a fitness app's home screen, including tabs for dashboard, workouts, goals, and profile. It also includes a notifications icon with a badge indicator.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that represents the main shell of the home screen with bottom navigation and app bar, managing tabs and notification badge.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: The state class managing the current tab index, building the UI including app bar, body, and navigation bar.

methods.name: _titleForIndex
methods.description: Returns the title string based on the current tab index.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the home screen, including app bar with notification icon and badge, current tab body, and bottom navigation bar.
